2122903278308446498.en_summary: @DanielTNiles for $NVDA it was a beat and raise quarter and even more than expected. Continues to believe at 10x CY27 PE vs the S&P at 17x the risk to reward is compelling given the nascency of Agentic AI. Top 10 takeaways include board unanimously accepted resignation and does not intend to reinstate Jensen as CEO, CY27 revenue growth guidance raised from 70% to 75% even including recent export controls, cloud industry backlog now $2.5 trillion vs $2.0 trillion 3 months ago, open models accelerating with AI adoption and weekly token volume on OpenRouter surged 35x YoY and 3.5x in past 3 months, agentic workloads ~80% of tokens, token prices fallen nearly 60% since May accelerating usage and GPU rental prices rising (Hopper up to 2x original, B300 +60%), purchase commitments increased to $390 billion, returned 65% of FCF YTD intends to return all excess, authorized additional $150 billion share repurchase (largest in history) exited Q3 with $227 billion remaining, Q4 expected bottom of gross margins before improving to 72-73% in FY28, neocloud commitments $32 billion total guarantees $118 billion. Previewed stock likely up on Wednesday in reaction to earnings guidance as second clearing event following resignation. This was even more than expected.
2122903278308446498.zh_summary: @DanielTNiles認為$NVDA是超預期且上調的季度，甚至超過預期。繼續相信以10倍CY27市盈率對比標普17倍，考慮到Agentic AI的萌芽期，風險回報具吸引力。十大要點包括董事會一致接受辭職且不打算讓Jensen復職執行長、CY27收入增長指引從70%上調至75%（即使包括最近出口管制）、雲行業積壓訂單現為2.5萬億對比3個月前2.0萬億、開放模型加速、OpenRouter上AI採用及每週token量同比激增35倍及過去3個月3.5倍、Agentic工作負載約佔token的80%、token價格自5月以來下跌近60%加速使用且GPU租金上升（Hopper高達原價2倍、B300上升60%以上）、採購承諾增至3900億、年初至今回饋65%自由現金流並計劃回饋所有超額、授權額外1500億股票回購（史上最大）第三季結束時剩餘2270億、第四季預期毛利率觸底後在財年28改善至72-73%、新雲承諾320億總擔保1180億。預覽週三因盈利指引可能上漲作為辭職後的第二個澄清事件。這甚至超過預期。
